claim: aligned same-unit measurements at t-1 and t-2 contain held-out predictive information about x_i(t+h) beyond a nonlinear function of x_i(t)
claim_not_identified: biological mechanism, anatomical graph, CloudCell, monad, consciousness, or AGI architecture
equation: xhat_i[t+h] = beta0 + g(x_i[t]) + beta1*x_i[t-1] + beta2*x_i[t-2], g=[x,x^2,x^3,tanh(x)]

split.selection: validation only; test is never used for transform, fit, or selection

null.policy: jointly circular-shift t-1 and t-2 columns within each train, validation, and test block; refit every null model
null.p_value: (1 + number(null median delta >= observed median delta)) / 20

synthetic_checks: test mutation leaves fitted-model hash unchanged
samples crossing acquisition gaps are excluded

decision_rule: No threshold, feature, horizon, or exclusion change is allowed after AML32 activity scores are computed.
